text: 1. At least 16 years old, with good physical and mental health. 2. Non-Chinese nationality: The determination method is in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Document No. 12 from the Ministry of Education's Department of Foreign Affairs [2020]". 3. High school graduation 4. Chinese proficiency requirement: A valid HSK certificate must be submitted. 1) Chinese Language and Chinese International Education Major (International students form their own classes): The HSK 4 level should generally be no less than 180 points. 2) For art-related majors: The HSK 4 level must reach 180 points (with each individual score generally not lower than 60 points); 3) Science and Engineering Majors: HSK Level 4 must reach 195 points (with each individual score generally not lower than 65 points); 4) For liberal arts and economics management majors: HSK Level 4 must score 210 points or HSK Level 5 must score 180 points (with individual scores generally not lower than 70 points) Those holding the following certificates may apply for exemption from submitting the HSK certificate. 1) The score of the SAT II Chinese (with Listening) examination is ≥ 600; 2) Have completed the IB Chinese HL course and achieved a score of 6 or above; 3) Have completed A-level Chinese courses and achieved grades of A or above; 4) Through the AP Chinese course or other proof; 5) Education at the secondary school level is conducted in the Chinese language. 6) Obtain the pre-scholarship program completion certificate from the Chinese government.
